method: Sequential isolated copies on the same D: filesystem; same learner, SGD momentum, replay, RNG and actor sequences. 8 games, 800 simulations/ply, 4096 replay samples, 2048 microbatch, 4096 newly committed positions per update. Reset only copied update_schedule cursor to copied replay total_positions so each case must collect a fresh 4096. Standard pipeline with monitor on (random private port), performance on, stop_after_publications=1. Timer starts before pipeline initialization and ends when the new actor export returns; startup export is excluded as a publication. No concurrent test workloads.
limitations: One full publication per variant, not a long-run average or confidence interval.
BF16 batch scheduling may change trajectories; complete-game admission changes overshoot and unfinished searches.
Cold startup, first SGD and disk writes included; steady-state publication periods may differ.
No strength claim; search budget, noise, temperature, model architecture and optimizer settings unchanged.

notes: Cumulative current-session rates; startup and unfinished searches are included in wall time
MCTS local CPU is a wall-time estimate, not process CPU time
Request RTT includes inference and queueing; it is not pure IPC overhead
Concurrent module times overlap and must not be added
P95 is a fixed-histogram approximate upper bound
CUDA events are sampled and read without additional synchronization
